messages:
elaine: Heads-up — seeing sustained memory growth on prod-rt-3 during longctx runs. KV residency for tenant:titan climbs steadily and doesn't decay; other tenants hit higher eviction churn. Noticed ~15% tail latency bump for small requests.

rahul: Any pprof/heapshot yet? can you paste top lines or flame?

elaine: grabbing heap + pprof now, link to upload in a sec. quick snippet from heap: 
```
allocated: 12.4GB # at 02:12:03
in-use-kv-pages: 9.8GB
tenant:titan residency: 6.1GB (62% of kv pages)
freeable-frag: 800MB
active-evictions: 220/s
```

infra-bot: alert: kv-residency:prod-rt-3 high-residency detected for tenant:titan (6.1GB). triggered runbook-kv-nudge.

tom: logs show frequent handoff churn around the same window — looks like repeated page handoffs instead of stealing. excerpt: 
```
[02:11:59] handoff started tenant=titan pages=128 -> dest=pool-B
[02:12:00] handoff failed: dest-busy
[02:12:01] fallback-evict tenant=other-tenant pages=64
[02:12:02] handoff retry tenant=titan pages=128
```

matt: my hunch: noisy tenant keeps re-priming hot prefixes (longctx). Our eviction/handoff backoff is too aggressive for repeated longctx reuse patterns. Also batching heuristics pick small batches causing higher per-page overhead.

jun: ran a quick local sim (10k longctx traces) with two tweaks: 1) residency decay half-life lowered from 30m -> 5m, 2) handoff batch size increased 128 -> 512. results: 
- peak titan residency down 28%
- avg eviction ops down 32%
- median request latency unchanged, p95 down 12%

sara: those sims sound promising but we need fairness constraints. propose soft-reserve + strict cap: guarantee X MB per tenant for steady-state, allow bursts up to cap with time-weighted charges. Also add a per-tenant eviction-rate circuit to avoid thrashing.

rahul: agree. can we implement quick prototyping flags? i'd like a canary: enable decay=5m + batch=512 + per-tenant soft-reserve=150MB for pool prod-rt-3-2 for 6h, compare residency curves and evictions.

elaine: scheduling canary now. command I'll run on infra: 
```
./deploy-config --pool prod-rt-3-2 --kv.decay_secs=300 --kv.handoff_batch=512 --kv.soft_reserve_mb=150 --tag=canary-tenant-sculpt
```

matt: also add a lightweight profiler to trace handoff vs eviction events, TTL them to s3: `/tmp/kv-handoff-trace-{{ts}}.log`

jun: post-canary quick numbers (after 2h): 
- titan residency: 6.1GB -> 4.3GB
- eviction ops: 220/s -> 140/s
- handoff retries: down 60%
- observed slight increase in cold misses for tiny-tenants (+4%)

sara: acceptable trade if tiny tenants don't regress SLA — need alert on small-tenant tail latency > 5% baseline.

infra-bot: deploy started: canary-tenant-sculpt -> prod-rt-3-2 by elaine at 1723345800

elaine: will let this run 6h and gather pprof/trace, then experiment to tune soft-reserve vs cap. thanks all. :white_check_mark:

rahul: next steps: define metrics (per-tenant residency, eviction-rate, handoff-retry-rate, p95 latency by tenant), schedule 2h postmortem tomorrow. assign owners: elaine (canary), jun (analysis), sara (SLAs).
_meta: generated for dataset: kv cache behavior + multi-tenant isolation
